description: This file defines the IObjectPoolMonitor interface, which specifies methods for monitoring object pool metrics such as allocation, release, and status reporting within the Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: IObjectPoolMonitor
classes.description: Interface for monitoring object pool metrics, including tracking object allocations, releases, and reporting pool status.

methods.name: TrackObjectAllocated
methods.description: Method called when an object is allocated from the pool.

methods.name: TrackObjectReleased
methods.description: Method called when an object is released back to the pool.

methods.name: Report
methods.description: Method to report the current status of the object pool, including total, available, and claimed objects.
